---
title: "check-paired-file-change.yml"
---

Fail a pull request that changes a file matching `trigger-paths` without also
changing a file matching `required-paths`, unless the PR carries the skip
label.

The first use is a macro library and the page that documents its notation:
a change to `macros.qmd` must come with a change to `notation-choices.qmd`
([Morrison-Lab/macros#248](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/macros/issues/248)).
Nothing in the check knows that pair; the paths are the caller's.

## What it compares

**The files the pull request changes.**
The check diffs `HEAD^1...HEAD` on a `pull_request` run,
where the checkout is GitHub's merge ref
and `HEAD^1` is the base tip it was built on.
On any other event there is no base, and the check skips with a notice.
A renamed file counts at both its old and its new path.

**Matching is git's own.**
Both path inputs are git pathspecs, comma- or newline-separated,
passed to `git diff --name-only`.
A bare `*` also crosses `/`; use `:(glob)` magic for `**`.

**The skip label is read live.**
The label is read from the API at the moment of the check,
because the event payload's labels are frozen at the triggering event
and miss any label applied later.
The read happens only when the check would otherwise fail, and an API error
fails the check rather than reading as "no labels".
An empty `skip-label` never matches.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger-paths` | string | required | Comma- or newline-separated git pathspecs. A changed file matching any of them requires a change matching `required-paths`. |
| `required-paths` | string | required | Comma- or newline-separated git pathspecs. At least one changed file must match one of them whenever a changed file matches `trigger-paths`. |
| `skip-label` | string | `'no-notation-change'` | PR label that waives the pairing, matched case-insensitively. Set to an empty string to disable the escape hatch. |
| `message` | string | see the workflow | Text shown in the failure annotation, saying what to update. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

An empty `trigger-paths` or `required-paths` is an error, not a pass.

## Permissions

Read-only: `contents: read`, plus `issues: read` and `pull-requests: read`
for the live label read.
A caller that pins the calling job's `permissions` must include all three.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check paired file change
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-paired-file-change.yml@v3
    with:
      trigger-paths: 'macros.qmd'
      required-paths: 'notation-choices.qmd'
      # skip-label: 'no-notation-change'
      # message: 'Update notation-choices.qmd to match the macro change.'
      # runs-on: private-runner  # self-hosted runner label (private repositories only)
```

See `check-paired-file-change.yml` in
[`examples/`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/tree/main/examples)
for the full caller stub.
